proposal.rationale: help() rendered every parameter twice through a CodepointCountingWriter (once into a discarding writer just to measure the max width, once to the real writer), so each small writeAll went through an unbuffered vtable drain plus two UTF-8 counting passes. Replace this with paramWidth(), which computes the same codepoint count directly from the param's name/value lengths (same UTF-8 counting function, invalid input still maps to WriteFailed), and print the param straight to the writer. usage() used the counting writer only to know whether anything had been written yet; that is now a bool. The output is byte-identical. help_ir drops about 51%, and examples_bytes shrinks by 1.4%.
